heading: CHAPTER VII.
title: CONCERNING NEW PRINCIPALITIES WHICH ARE ACQUIRED EITHER BY THE ARMS OF OTHERS OR BY GOOD FORTUNE
exclusions: front matter and dedication before THE PRINCE
notes: Dense premium chapter centered on Cesare Borgia as a case study in post-ascent foundation building.
